rationale: Zero-market-minute maintenance buckets can never contain admissible market evidence. The repair only prevents an impossible calendar bucket from marking the whole snapshot partial; raw M1 admission, aggregate OHLC, PIT timestamps, revisions and all non-empty bucket semantics are unchanged.

invariants: For every bucket with one or more expected market minutes, completeness ratio and admissibility semantics are unchanged.
aggregate_m1 still emits no candle for a zero-market-minute bucket before and after this repair.
No raw M1 row, aggregate OHLC value, revision lineage, first_observed_at timestamp, or PIT admission rule changes.
The only behavioral change is snapshot readiness: a calendar bucket containing zero possible market minutes is classified not_applicable instead of falsely making the capture partial.
